record_scope_reconstruction: Swedish December28–January21 negative-test-only selected admission phase includes Øresund; January5 reporting specifically locates road checks at Lernacken toll station. Bridge midpoint is qualified context only, not a checkpoint coordinate.

source_checks.finding: Official December23 notice announces negative result within48h for December28 arrivals.
Official January31 account says48h-specific test requirement ceased January21; EEA/Nordic entrants again could present vaccination, recovery or72h negative test.
January5 report explicitly describes almost100% Swedish checks at Lernacken, queues and exemptions; not total bridge closure.
Published named combined road/rail bridge reference coordinate; underlying OSM inaccessible.
